kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

lines.say: Two nights before Christmas. End the day with this one.
Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth:
lines.big: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth:

lines.say: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise. Psalm ninety eight, verse four.
lines.big: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

lines.say: Joy to the World was written from this psalm. Let it be your last song tonight.
lines.big: Joy to the World was written from this psalm. Let it be your last song tonight.

lines.say: Lord, thank you for coming into the world. Fill my heart with joy tonight. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 79 through 104, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
